name: Genha
source:
One of the strongest members of the terrorist organization Fei Dao, he's obsessed with causing terror and harming others. Being a terrorist is just a way of having fun for him. He has a very sharp intuition, heightened strength and reflexes. 
[spoiler]One of the three testing subjects in the early developments of the brain-washing chip. Unlike Liang, he does not suffer from memory loss, but he seems to have an evil consciousness inside him telling him to do evil. What he did gain eight years ago is a strengthened right brain, making him far more athletic than others. [/spoiler]

[Edited from [url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=character&charid=10461]AniDB[/url]]
